name: Smoke Bomb
description:
You can use the Hide maneuver even if you are observed and don’t initially have cover or concealment. When you do so, you can shift a number of squares equal to your Agility score. If you end this movement with cover or concealment, you are automatically hidden.

Combat Tools: Cover-only enemies stop counting as observing you, so the Hide button and the panel take them. Hiding with no cover at all is still the Director’s call: target them and use Hide from Targeted.

Draw Steel: Heroes p. 162.
